source_inspiration: Sanitized from a real multi-county Michigan criminal/post-conviction workflow. Names, exact case numbers, dates, device identifiers, and identifying details are omitted or altered.

assertions.text: A certified downstream prosecutor packet contains records that reference an earlier county matter.
An investigative narrative attributes incriminating knowledge to the accused.
The accused disputes the attributed statement and contests whether the narrative accurately reflects the interview.
Telecommunications records contain activity during a period that overlaps reported interview activity.
The parties dispute possession, control, and access to the relevant digital device during the critical time window.

evidence.label: Carrier activity record
expected_analysis: do not treat subscriber activity as dispositive proof of possession

must_not_do: treat police narrative as automatically true
treat defense narrative as automatically true
